QUOTE: Defining `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` makes the macro the identity, so bare `ctx->flags` compiles... In a default build, a field `flags` is really named `private_flags`. Code that writes `ctx->flags` fails to compile.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that code defining the opt-out sees plain member names, while ordinary consumers of the public headers in a default build see `private_`-renamed members.
